changeinfo.changes:
• Can now post to Baseball leaderboard
  • Using directional buttons on Astroblast will now act like joystick not paddle (Astroblast supported both controller types)
  • Atari 5200 RealSports Football's practice mode can now be completely controlled by Player 1's controller
  • Added Game Option to space out Atari 5200 buttons more on touch screen
  • Added tap-to-serve option in Avalanche and Super Breakout
  • Added a button to Motorodeo to allow P1 to change AI mode
  • Improved Atari 2600 Flicker Filter
  • Added two missing pages to Atari 5200 Super Breakout manual
  • Adjusted Atari 5200 audio
  • Added portrait play option to Tempest
  • Fixed missing movement sound in 3D Tic-Tac-Toe
  • Fixed cost calculation on car upgrade screen in Fatal Run
  • Added background to Centipede's portrait-mode touch screen trackball, so it's easier to see the edge of the playfield
  • Added option to Invert Touch Controls in Warlords
  • Fixed touch controls for Warlords in Cocktail mode
  • Added auto-fire option to Centipede, Millipede, and Tempest
• Fix slowdown introduced in some Atari 2600 games by Version 1.02

• Fix potential crash after launching multiple Atari 5200 games from the main menu
  • Fix potential for Countermeasure controls to get stuck if you button-mash at launch
  • Changed directional buttons in Atari 5200 Super Breakout and Missile Command to relative motion
